meta.name: neon-postgres
meta.description: Guides and best practices for working with Lakebase Postgres on Neon: connections, pooled vs direct, schema migrations, branching, autoscaling, scale-to-zero, instant restore, read replicas, IP allow lists, logical replication, and Lakebase Search. Use when the work is an existing DATABASE_URL, SQL, schema, inspect, or search. New backends, Auth, files, Functions, and LLM calls go to the parent `neon` skill. Also use for "@neondatabase/serverless", "@neondatabase/neon-js", "neon inspect db", "semantic search", "vector search", "full-text search", "BM25", or "hybrid search".

copy.tagline: 把云数据库的连接、建表改表和数据搜索配得又稳又省
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在 Neon 上用 Postgres,要管连接、表结构变更和搜索
copy.tagline_en: Tune cloud Postgres connections, schema changes, and search the right way
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Postgres on Neon and manage connections, migrations, and search

howto.what: Claude 会帮你操作 Neon 上的 Lakebase Postgres：选项目、取连接串、管 schema 与迁移、建分支、跑只读诊断，并按场景区分连接池与直连。
howto.when: 当任务围绕已有的 DATABASE_URL、SQL 或 schema 等数据库工作时触发；新后端、认证、文件等归上层 neon 技能。

say.text: 帮我用直连对这个项目的 DATABASE_URL 跑一次 schema 迁移
say.note: 它会绕开连接池、用直连串执行

say.text: 用 neon inspect db 看看哪些索引没被用到
say.note: 跑只读诊断，只给候选列表

say.text: 从生产分支建一个分支来测这次迁移
say.note: 得到即时的写时复制克隆

howto.what_en: Claude works on your Lakebase Postgres on Neon: picking projects and connection strings, managing schemas and migrations, branching, and running read-only diagnostics, choosing pooled or direct connections as needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the work centers on an existing DATABASE_URL, SQL, or schema; new backends, auth, and files go to the parent neon skill.

say_en.text: Run the schema migration on this project's DATABASE_URL using a direct connection
say_en.note: It uses the direct, non-pooled string

say_en.text: Use neon inspect db to find unused indexes
say_en.note: Runs a read-only check, returns candidates

say_en.text: Create a branch off production to test this migration
